description: Search memories via hybrid vector+keyword search, scoped to a namespace. Defaults the namespace to the vault folder name; pass an explicit `namespace` to search memories that live under a different namespace (e.g. after memory_export_vault).

namespace.description: Namespace to search. Defaults to the vault folder name — set this when your memories live in a namespace different from the vault directory name (e.g. after memory_export_vault wrote them under <vault>/<namespace>/).

offset.description: Skip this many results for pagination

query.description: Search query — supports natural language for semantic search and keywords for exact matching

search_mode.description: Search mode: hybrid (vector+keyword), vector only, or keyword only

tags.description: Filter to memories containing ALL specified tags

vault_path.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault directory

name: vault_search
